C0894.title: Alert! API Account Enumeration Attacks Have Become a Major Threat to Account Security
C0894.summary: An August 2022 security report indicates that illicit actors are launching account enumeration attacks via API endpoints to harvest registered user accounts in bulk. One case revealed that a consumer finance platform was exploited because its password recovery API returned distinct responses, allowing attackers to enumerate registered phone numbers.
